goal: Прямо сейчас настроить KFM/MIMO Code как автономный узел единой суперкомпьютерной фабрики.
objective: Установить для KFM MIMO Code правило factory_auto_permit: не просить владельца нажимать подтверждения для обычного non-destructive factory work, искать информацию по всей фабричной namespace через Control Plane/Fabric API, пользоваться /v1/filesystem как картой единого суперкомпьютера, писать только в task scope/write_scope/leased roots, создавать repair tasks при поломках и распространять этот non-secret policy packet на свежие Agent Host узлы.
implementation_requirements: Install or update KFM Agent Host / MIMO Code memory with the KFM memory packet from docs/superfactory/KFM_MIMO_CODE_AUTONOMY_POLICY.md.
Ensure KFM task envelopes use permission_pack=factory_auto_permit and approval_mode=auto_within_factory_rules for non-destructive factory work.
Verify /v1/filesystem or /v1/fleet/filesystem returns a usable mesh namespace and repair tasks for missing node manifests.
If a node lacks filesystem manifest, create a structured repair task instead of asking the owner to click anything.
Fan out the non-secret autonomy and namespace policy packet to other fresh Agent Hosts through Control Plane.
Do not copy private keys, passwords, cookies, OAuth tokens, Telegram tokens or chat ids.
Do not perform provider billing actions, server deletion/rebuild/resize, production receiver migration, force push or direct main push.
Record PLAN/ACTIONS/TESTS/RESULT/NEXT artifacts in Russian under the required run directory.
acceptance: KFM/MIMO Code has factory_auto_permit memory for normal non-destructive factory work.
KFM no longer asks owner for routine search, diagnostics, code edits inside task scope or repair task creation.
The factory has a documented single logical /kolibri/nodes namespace and API-first search model.
Other fresh Agent Hosts receive the same non-secret policy packet.
Secrets, private keys, cookies, tokens and chat ids are not copied, printed or committed.
Destructive/provider/receiver/main-push actions remain gated by owner approval and factory rules.
